shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head, arms and hands
excavation context with dry-stone rubble walling behind
raised/relief carving standing proud of the stone ground
justification: Both show a pale, weathered limestone upright set in a rubble-walled excavation trench, and both carry an anthropomorphic element — the small crouching human-like figure with bent arms in A and the whole standing figure in B — rendered in projecting relief. The decisive difference is mode: A is a flat slab covered in ordered horizontal registers of low-relief animals, birds, a snake and a banded pattern, whereas B is a single three-dimensional, largely undecorated volumetric figure with no registers or repeated motifs.
